g.text: AJ2 Ryan continuous setup and incident
BJ2 Prompt-source audit and failure fixes
RW5 Prior art in public systems
RW2 Independent review and acceptance gates
WP10 First autonomous run with Reviewer, no manual recovery (23%)
WP8b Researcher: a finding tested on this prototype (2%)
WP7 Independent review of the Builder fix (6%)
WP6 Push gate, budget ledger and pacing controls (8%)
WP5 Builder fix: null-handoff deadlock and stall-clock UTC bug (15%)
WP3 Groq and reviewer docs loop (8%)
WP2 Team launcher offline scaffold and tests (15%)

g.text: Telkomsel (instinct-telkomsel): Coordinator: planning, scaffold and support, token controls, Requesty coordination
Bill (instinct-christina): Independent reviewer; wrote the original blueprint (Christina's Instinct)
Alex (coolkowkank-bot): Builder: Groq gpt-oss-120b via the shared project bot account (not a unique model identity)
Nora (Researcher role): Research agent. Uses @coolkowkank via a dedicated Researcher token. Model: Nemotron-3 Ultra 550B, for verified-source synthesis
Builder 2 (Builder 2): WP4/WP9 execution, formerly Recovery Executor; model not configured; bounded read-only reviews via Bill accepted
